**⚠️ Game Page Loads But Shows White Screen**

The server and nginx are fully configured and working:

## Working Routes
```
✅ https://arelorian.de/           → Client HTML (200)
✅ https://arelorian.de/assets/   → Static assets (200)  
✅ https://arelorian.de/client-config.json → Config with ws://arelorian.de/ws (200)
✅ https://arelorian.de/world/are-performance-policy.json → Policy (200)
✅ https://arelorian.de/ws       → WebSocket proxy → localhost:3000
```

## Issues
- **White screen**: Client loads but renderer not drawing
- Common causes: WebGL not available, canvas not initializing, JS error

## Next Steps to Debug
1. Open browser DevTools (F12) → Check Console for errors
2. Check Network tab for failed WebSocket connection
3. Try on different browser (Chrome with hardware acceleration)

The infrastructure is all working - the issue is client-side JavaScript/WebGL rendering.
